type.description: The type of the question. If not specified, `normal` is assumed.

text.description: The sentence that is shown when this question is selected.

image.description: Optional image that is shown next to `text`. Either a relative file path or `b64:` followed by base64 data

solution.description: The solution to the question. This is only for the moderator and not shown to the players.

solutionImage.description: Optional image that is shown as the solution, after the question is solved. Either a relative file path or `b64:` followed by base64 data

name.description: Name of the category, shown in the header of the board.

version.description: Version of the board schema. If not specified, version 1 will be assumed.

mult.description: Multiplier for question point values. Default is 100
